dedupe_keys.name: simultaneous temperature and consolidation sensing near drinking water wells using fiber optic sensors

description: The provider publishes a drinking-water well-field monitoring bundle with fibre-optic sensor observations and autoregressive models. Eight native metadata items include Matlab datasets and ARX models, processing code, well and sensor maps, sensor depths and organisation documentation. The parent description identifies sensors installed forty metres deep and methods separating pressure and temperature response. Coverage: Individual native time-coverage fields and dates apply separately; no common interval is imposed. Geographic extent follows the named site or scope; unstated extents and sampling intervals remain unknown. Access: public 4TU.ResearchData metadata links describe the release. Formats: tool-specific files, source scripts, images or videos, documents, spreadsheets. Licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Cost and present file access are unverified. Caveats: The maps and README are grouped with the measurement bundle. No map, source-code file, PDF or measurement contents were opened; runtime model behaviour is untested. Simulation uses follow the source-defined purpose above. Related resources are retained in the same native collection with their distinct identities.
